_doc: Hand-curated major canon events per saga, with chapter citations. Used by timeline.html as the meaty layer alongside arc structure + character debuts. Add via PR with chapter citation. Each event: chapter, title, summary, type (debut/death/battle/reveal/alliance/transformation/political).

events.title: Luffy departs Foosha Village
events.summary: The journey begins. Shanks gives Luffy his straw hat as a promise.

events.title: Luffy meets Coby
events.summary: First encounter with the boy who'll become a Marine Captain.

events.title: Strawhat name origin
events.summary: Crew identity forms around Luffy's iconic hat.

events.title: Mihawk vs Zoro
events.summary: Zoro's first defeat; he vows never to lose again.

events.title: Arlong Park falls
events.summary: Nami officially joins; Luffy destroys Arlong Park.

events.title: Roger's execution remembered
events.summary: Loguetown — Buggy nearly executes Luffy. Origin of Roger's last words established.

events.title: Crew enters Grand Line
events.summary: Reverse Mountain — the Grand Line begins.

events.title: Crocodile defeated
events.summary: Alabasta saved. Vivi farewell. First Warlord falls to Luffy.

events.title: Enel defeated
events.summary: Sky Island arc climax. Going Merry's golden bell of Shandora rung.

events.title: Robin says 'I want to live!'
events.summary: Water 7 → Enies Lobby. Strawhats burn the World Government flag.

events.title: Lucci defeated
events.summary: Luffy's first taste of Gear Second/Third on this scale. CP9 falls.

events.title: Going Merry's farewell
events.summary: The first ship's funeral. Strawhats weep on the open sea.

events.title: Brook joins
events.summary: Thriller Bark concludes. The crew gains its musician.

events.title: Kuma scatters the Strawhats
events.summary: Each crew member sent across the world. The 2-year separation begins.

events.title: Ace dies
events.summary: Marineford. Akainu's magma fist through Ace's chest. Luffy's worst hour.

events.title: Whitebeard dies standing
events.summary: Edward Newgate's final declaration: 'One Piece is real.'

events.title: 2-year timeskip begins
events.summary: Luffy's '3D2Y' message. The crew trains.

events.title: Strawhats reach the New World
events.summary: Fishman Island concludes. Hody Jones defeated. Crew enters the second half of the Grand Line.

events.title: Doflamingo defeated
events.summary: King Punch / Gear Fourth / Conqueror's Haki. Dressrosa freed.

events.title: Sabo eats the Mera Mera no Mi
events.summary: Ace's flame-flame fruit lives on through his sworn brother.

events.title: Pedro/Carrot reveal Zou tribe
events.summary: Zou arc concludes. Mink-Strawhat alliance formed. Road poneglyphs in motion.

events.title: Whole Cake escape
events.summary: Strawhats narrowly escape Big Mom Pirates. Sanji rescued.

events.title: Imu revealed
events.summary: Reverie. The hidden sovereign of the Five Elders sits the Empty Throne. Lore-shaking.

events.title: Strawhat & Heart & Kid Alliance vs Yonko
events.summary: Three Worst Generation captains face Big Mom and Kaidou simultaneously. Onigashima rooftop.

events.title: Kaidou defeated
events.summary: Luffy's awakened Hito Hito Nika fells the strongest creature. Wano free.

events.title: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika revealed
events.summary: Luffy's Devil Fruit was always a Mythical Zoan — Sun God Nika. The Gomu Gomu name was a 'lie' by the World Government for 800 years.

events.title: Buggy becomes Yonko
events.summary: The Cross Guild reshapes the Yonko balance. Mihawk + Crocodile + Buggy as figurehead.

events.title: Egghead arc opens
events.summary: Vegapunk's island unveiled. Lilith first appears.

events.title: All six Vegapunk satellites revealed
events.summary: Edison, Pythagoras, Atlas, Shaka, Lilith, York — the six brain-bodies of Dr. Vegapunk.

events.title: Law vs Blackbeard
events.summary: Awakened Ope Ope no Mi. Law captured.

events.title: Imu's silhouette in colour
events.summary: The Empty Throne's occupant gets a clearer reveal. World Government lore breaks open.

events.title: Five Elders attack Vegapunk
events.summary: Saint Saturn arrives on Egghead. Vegapunk's broadcast begins.

events.title: Vegapunk's broadcast
events.summary: The truth about the Void Century begins to leak. World shakes.

events.title: Bunt Kingdom revealed
events.summary: New World political development.

events.title: Most recent canon
events.summary: Latest official chapter as of vault generation. Codex updates weekly.
